verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal coding agent, and automatic PR review is a reasonable thing to ask of this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no pull-request integration, no automatic trigger on PRs, and no review-comment posting. The only review-related item is an example prompt asking the agent to review a codebase's architecture, which is a manual one-off request rather than automatic per-PR review.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
